# Color vision

OKLab ΔE×100 between every pair the system means to be told apart, simulated under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia at full severity (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes, 2009). The margin is 6, three just-noticeable differences, and 9 on the green/brown and blue/purple confusion axes. A pair that something besides color separates, a glyph or a word, is reported against its margin and not enforced. A pair separated by color alone fails the build below it. Brand OS modes resolve exactly like Atmo's and are omitted where identical.
